phases.phase_name: Phase 3.2 — LightGBM Candidate Model & Comparative Evaluation

tasks.description: Implement LightGBM training pipeline with early stopping on identical route-group split.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: LightGBM trained strictly on Train split without leakage on identical GroupShuffleSplit.
tasks.test_evidence: Trained on 69,505 rows with early stopping on 15,044 validation rows. Serialized to models/lightgbm_candidate.joblib in 2.69s.

tasks.description: Comparative evaluation against locked Logistic Regression baseline; promote to champion ONLY if PR-AUC >= 0.1500 and ROC-AUC >= 0.6500.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Side-by-side metrics logged. Candidate promoted to champion only if superior across PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, Brier score, and threshold metrics.
tasks.rollback_steps: Retain Logistic Regression as baseline champion in models/model_metadata.json.
tasks.test_evidence: Evaluated on identical 15,451 test rows. LightGBM Test PR-AUC: 0.1174, ROC-AUC: 0.5623, Brier: 0.0823, Latency: 0.0061 ms/sample. Mandatory promotion gate enforced: below 0.1500 threshold, baseline Logistic Regression preserved as Champion. 8/8 tests in tests/test_model_candidate.py passed.

phases.phase_name: Phase 3.3 — Probability Calibration & Operational Threshold Validation

tasks.description: Implement leakage-safe 5-Fold GroupKFold Platt scaling on out-of-fold predictions and verify calibration transfer validity.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Platt scaling eliminates calibration bias without degrading PR-AUC; Kolmogorov-Smirnov test verifies calibration transfer to full development model (D < 0.05).
tasks.rollback_steps: Remove models/calibrator_*.joblib; git checkout src/calibrator.py src/train_model.py.
tasks.test_evidence: Platt calibration reduced LR bias from +0.4021 to 0.0000 and Brier score to 0.0824 (Brier skill score +0.0055 vs baseline 0.0829) while preserving PR-AUC 0.1173 and ROC-AUC 0.5683. KS transfer audit passed with D=0.0105 (LR) and D=0.0140 (LGB). tests/test_calibration.py passed 7/7 tests.

tasks.description: Execute 5-step formal threshold validation procedure considering asymmetric loss functions and hard <= 20% fleet capacity constraint.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Operational cutoffs validated on development data and audited once on Quarantined Test Set (seed=2026); fleet capacity <= 20% satisfied; capacity ranking fallback implemented in RiskEngine.
tasks.test_evidence: Selected tau_low=0.110 and tau_med=0.140. Evaluated on untouched Quarantined Test Set (N=14,819): intervention rate 14.66% satisfies <= 20% capacity limit, capturing 292 failures with 13.44% precision, yielding $1,040 (7.6%) net cost savings under Scenario 2. Promotion gate rejected (PR-AUC 0.1178 < 0.1500), preserving Logistic Regression as Champion. Full regression suite passed 36/36 tests.

phases.phase_name: Phase 3.4 — Risk Engine Integration & Banding Enforcement

tasks.description: Centralize risk banding in _assign_risk_band, add predict_batch, separate statistical risk tiers from capacity allocation in apply_capacity_constrained_policy, and handle deterministic tie-breaking.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RiskEngine predicts calibrated probabilities and assigns LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH tiers consistently across single and batch calls; capacity policy preserves input ordering and tie-breaking; 44/44 regression tests pass.
tasks.test_evidence: Added TestPhase34RiskEngineIntegrationAndBanding with 8 unit tests in tests/test_engine.py. Verified exact threshold boundaries, batch/single equivalence, deterministic tie-breaking, capacity separation, input order preservation, and resilience against empty/invalid inputs. Full regression suite passed 44/44 tests in 31.57s.

tasks.description: Implement unified explainability engine in calibrated log-odds space: LinearExplainerChampion for Logistic Regression and TreeExplainerCandidate for LightGBM with dual-compatible schema and explicit fallback.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Exact local accuracy sum(phi_j) == z_cal - base_value; risk_driver_share strictly within (0, 1] for positive drivers; attribution-only latency <= 0.5ms Champion and <= 10.0ms Candidate; dual-compatible schema preserving legacy factor, detail, severity; 56/56 regression tests pass.
tasks.rollback_steps: Restore .pre_3_5.bak backups for requirements.txt, src/risk_engine.py, tests/test_engine.py; remove src/explainers.py and models/background_mean_champion.joblib.
tasks.test_evidence: Added TestPhase35ExplainabilityEngine with 12 unit tests in tests/test_engine.py. Verified exact additivity, base value consistency, share bounds, feature alignment, model switching, edge cases (zero/few drivers), and fallback. Measured Champion attribution latency: 0.091ms median (target <= 0.5ms); Candidate TreeSHAP latency: 3.137ms median (target <= 10.0ms). Full regression suite passed 56/56 tests in 22.86s.

tasks.description: Update FastAPI endpoints to serve calibrated predictions, risk tiers, fleet-capacity decisions, and SHAP explainability with live model switching.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: /api/predict, /api/predict/batch, and /api/intervene/simulate return structured responses with status 200; 20% fleet capacity cap enforced with order preservation; safe model switching between Champion and Candidate verified; all 8 API integration tests and 58/58 regression tests pass.
tasks.test_evidence: All 8 API integration tests in tests/test_api.py passed in 20.66s. Verified calibrated failure probability, badge colors, SHAP attributions and metadata, batch ranking with 20% fleet capacity cap (DEFERRED_DUE_TO_FLEET_CAPACITY), input order preservation, and bidirectional model switching between Champion Logistic Regression (Linear SHAP) and Candidate LightGBM (TreeSHAP) with guaranteed Champion restoration. Full regression suite passed 58/58 tests in 48.88s.

tasks.description: Map TreeSHAP root causes to ranked prescriptive options, enforce monotonic feature bounds, eliminate arbitrary clamp overrides, and apply dual-threshold recommendation policy with multi-channel messaging preview.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Applied customer preferences natively reduce model-predicted failure probabilities monotonically; zero clamp overrides; low-risk deliveries receive recommended=False; SMS/WhatsApp/Email templates validated; 7/7 intervention tests pass.
tasks.rollback_steps: git checkout src/risk_engine.py src/messaging.py app/server.py; rm tests/test_interventions.py.
tasks.test_evidence: tests/test_interventions.py passed 7/7 tests in 2.1s. All 8 baseline response keys preserved alongside Phase 5 utility and explainability fields. Monotonic risk reduction verified with 0 regressions. MessageDispatcher generates valid notifications across SMS, WhatsApp, and Email.

tasks.description: Implement pure Python/NumPy deterministic Nearest-Neighbor + 2-Opt TSP route optimizer with Haversine distance, urban circuity modeling (1.35), and smart locker intervention consolidation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Route optimizer computes verifiable pre- vs. post-intervention route metrics using Haversine with circuity factor 1.35, achieves >= 12% distance reduction benchmark on test route, and exposes POST /api/route/optimize.
tasks.rollback_steps: Remove src/route_optimizer.py and tests/test_routes.py; git checkout app/server.py.
tasks.test_evidence: tests/test_routes.py passed 6/6 tests. Benchmark on 30-stop Los Angeles manifest (RouteID_00143bdd-0a6b-49ec-bb35-36593d303e77) achieved 69.9% distance reduction (27.55 km to 8.29 km), far exceeding the >=12.0% requirement. Sub-10ms execution latency. Full test suite reached 74/74 passing tests in 31.63s.
